newsitem.title: USA: HON to acquire Allsteel from BTR.
newsitem.headline: HON to acquire Allsteel from BTR.

text.p: HON Industries Inc, which makes medium priced office furniture, said Tuesday it agreed to purchase, from BTR Plc, Allsteel Inc, which is also a manufacturer of mid-priced office furniture.
Terms of the proposed transaction were not disclosed.
Allsteel, which operates five manufacturing facilities, distributes its furniture through independent office products dealers and national dealer networks. It had 1996 sales of about $150 million.
HON said the acquisition will not be dilutive to earnings.
The proposed transaction requires regulatory clearance and is expected to close in June. HON said it plans to finance the deal acquisition with cash and bank debt.
HON also said it expects to continue to manufacture and sell a separate line of Allsteel office furniture.

"We see a significant opportunity to improve the profitability of this buisness through enahnced productivity, better purchasing, reduced operating costs, and improved delivery times to customers," said Jack Michaels, HON chairman, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
HON said it expects to use the available excess capacity of the five Allsteel plants to accommodate anticipated future sales growth.
